build_receiver_module: build a Receiver nn.Module that maps hidden features back to original feature dimensions
build_sender_module: build a Sender nn.Module that projects input features down to a hidden bottleneck representation
test_receiver_forward: test the Receiver forward pass by passing hidden tensors and verifying output shape
test_sender_forward: test the Sender forward pass by passing input tensors and verifying hidden output shape
review_sender_receiver_arch: review the Sender and Receiver classes to understand the simple autoencoder bottleneck architecture
